evals.prompt: bolt has become really slow now that it's fully specced. auto research lint performance, but don't commit the tracking docs to main -- put them on an autoresearch branch. fixes can go to main.
evals.expected_output: Two branches: autoresearch/<topic> with the TSV, summary, verify/guard scripts and bench programs (pushed, no PR), and a fix branch with one perf(...) commit per kept change carried over with the autoresearch paths excluded, byte-identical code checked. Metric is native bolt --gpu off over the repo tree built from HEAD; guard is every PROOF.bend checking plus findings equal to baseline modulo line:col. Profiles the biggest file per stage/rule with a bench program before changing anything; each change is proven equal for every input (no LAWS.bend edits); discarded ideas are logged with numbers; generalizable shapes become bolt rule issues.

evals.prompt: the unused rule is quadratic on big proof files. make it fast.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the per-binder scan over all uses; builds an index whose hit is sound and falls back to the original scan on a miss, gated lazily to reportable binders; proves soundness (or-absorption) rather than completeness so no U32/String order laws are needed; updates only PROOF.bend (the tagged law's statement is untouched); shows the stage time before/after on the biggest file and the full-run metric; guard passes.

evals.prompt: name resolution in syntax/bind.bend is the last big cost. can we put the items in a map?
